_comment: Extension Windows/Edge regression — 1 of 4 same-named 'Extension' runs distinguished only by Testmo Configuration. NARROW variant: case selection is driven by the Testmo tag 'extension-essential' (applied server-side by the /cases API), with no folder or test-type filter — the tag itself defines the scope, so any test type is eligible. State and automation filters still apply, so retired cases and already-automated ones are excluded. Configuration = 'Windows, Edge'. TWO-STEP RUN — the API only reproduces step 1. STEP 2 IS MANUAL: after creating this run, in the Testmo UI remove the cases whose configurations do not apply to Windows/Edge. Reason: Testmo's /cases API cannot filter by configuration and exposes no per-case config assignment. config_id 15 = 'Windows, Edge' (verified 2026-08-28). Tag id 17190.
